resources.string: You arrive at tech today, ready to start on an app challenge. But today is different somehow, it seems unusually empty at tech today; hardly any people here.\nYou walk upstairs to your classroom and there\'s no-one in the halls… \"How odd\" you say. Once you enter the classroom, the power flickers, frightening other students from across the hall. The bell sounds its imprudent ringing. \"There\'s no-one here…\"

You go to the door and look around. Then you notice there\'s not a single person here… \"If there\'s no-one here, how did I hear other people?\". Then you hear a noise, a pertinacious clanking coming from the end of the hall. Do you:
You hide under a desk, hoping the clanking creature did\'nt notice you. Unfortunately it noticed you… You can hear it getting closer, each metallic step increasing your anxiety. Do you:

You run as quickly as you can. As you\'re going through the door, you look back and see the creature. It\'s a robotic evil Mr. Mason?!?! There\'s no time to question why though, so you continue down the stairwell. Do you:

You run across the hall into the neighboring classroom, hoping there would be other students. Sadly there was only you and an empty classroom; devoid of people. You search for anything of use. You find a heavy shelf you could use to block the entrance and the best hiding spot you\'ve ever seen. You think to yourself \"How did I even notice this?\". Do you:

You block the door with the shelf. The metal creature is right outside, it starts banging on the heavy shelf unable to get in. You peek through the windows for a split-second. You see an evil robot Mr. Mason?!?! He sees you. A somewhat loud whirling noise begins. The shelf is engulfed in a blue light and vanishes before your eyes. Do you:

You hide in the legendary spot. It\'s the most inconspicuous box you\'ve ever seen! You see through the small cutout of the box, an evil robot Mr. Mason?!?! The robot looks around; confused as to how you disappeared. It turns around; heading away as it says \"LOW POWER. NEED TO CHARGE. NEED MORE TIES\". \"Ties?\" you think. Do you:

You decide to follow the robot while hiding in the box. Every so often, evil robot Mr. Mason looks around and notices the box but pays it no circuitry. It continues on until it goes into a dark room, hidden away from the rest of tech while it charges. It steps on its charging pad and quickly starts gaining power. You sneakily unplug the charging pad, next do you:

You accept this awful ending… \n\nYou wake up in your bed, alarm ringing. "That was an awful dream". You get up ready to go to tech; already forgetting the dream. You arrive at tech, ready to start an app challenge…

You attempt to escape! In your frantic escape, you trip on a wire. The evil robot on your heels, you get back up and keep running, but it\'s to late. You\'ve been engulfed by a blue light and find yourself outside tech, on top a familiar shelf

You successfully sneak out of tech by a little known door near the back. You look around and find no-one; probably because this entrance isn\'t really used often. You go home and watch the news about the invasion, \"Heh lousy invasion\" you think to yourself
You decide to reprogram the robot to steal ties all for yourself; you embrace evil.\n\nYears later, you\'re the only person on the planet that has ties… Any and every variation of a tie you now own
You decide to shutdown the robot forever and walk out of tech a hero. You don\'t know why that happened, nor why it was hunting you, but you escaped and saved the other students

You find the door locked and the robot is already behind you. You plead with the robot, \"Noooo! Please!\". It says in a robotic voice, \"GIVE ME YOUR TIES\". Unfortunately you don\'t have any ties. In the desperation of the moment, you steal one of the ties adorned around the robots neck and offer it, but alas it\'s too late. You\'re encased in a blue aura of light… You find yourself outside of tech, with a tie. At least you have a tie

You run to the main entrance and meet locked doors. The robot is right behind you though so you start running again, and the robot doesn\'t like it. The Mr. Mason lookalike begins firing with two different lasers, red and blue. As you run you trip over your own feet and get hit with both colors of laser. It\'s a mystery what happened to you
You continue hiding; hoping you misunderstood what was happening. You slowly open your eyes to see an evi… You got turned into a tie
